name: motion-camera-parallax
title: Parallax Layers
description: Ba lớp cùng đi một quãng nhưng lớp trước đi trọn, lớp giữa một nửa, lớp sau một phần năm.

moworks.author: takayu

options.distance: px the front travels (180; 60 on the site's frame); middle half, back a fifth (by data-depth)
options.loop: true: a seamless sine there and back (the site's demo); false: constant speed

credit.author: TakayuStudio (motion-reference)
credit.licence: No licence stated: idea and numbers only
credit.madeNote: written here from the idea and its numbers; none of the source's code

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio cam-parallax, written here): Parallax: one travel D; foreground moves D x 1.0, mid D x 0.5, background D x 0.2, linear constant speed over the shot (demo: 4 s, D = +-60 px as a sine loop). Params: distance (60 px) · depth (1 / 0.5 / 0.2) · duration (4 s).
